name: LMS-Mark Academy
tagline: Clinical skills courses taught by practising clinicians.
course_format: All courses are self-paced video lessons with a short quiz and a certificate on completion, with lifetime access.
how_to_enrol: Open the course page on the academy website and choose Enrol. This is a demo academy: enrolment and payment are simulated.
how_to_get_help: Ask in the website chat, or message us on Instagram or Messenger. Choose Talk to a person to reach the team.
